_comment: Canonical model/effort registry (#370). tier_palette.py derives the ordered MODELS/EFFORTS tuples from these explicit rank/rung indices at import — this file is the single source of vocabulary ordering. ORDERING IS LOAD-BEARING: rank 0 is the strongest model, rung 0 is the weakest effort. effort_ceiling is the strongest effort a model actually runs (haiku clamps below xhigh). Grow the vocabulary here, never with a second bare literal elsewhere — see plugins/fleet-core/references/tier-palette.md.
